name: competition-results-table
title: Competition results table
description: Results of a race or competition by category: place, athlete, club, finish time and gap to the winner, with ties, records and non-finishers named in words.
docs: Pass results ({ place, name, club, bib, category, time, status, marks, note }) in any order and categories ({ id, label }) for the tabs; a result's category is the id of one of them. time is seconds or text such as '1:02:45', '20:15.4' or '58.42', and is written the way a results sheet writes it (with hours once any time needs them) and read out in words. Places come from the times, and athletes with the same time share a place and are marked 'equal'; give every finisher an official place and the table trusts those instead (a photo finish, a penalty). A category tab narrows the table and counts the places again inside it; control it with category and onCategoryChange, or start it with defaultCategory. An entry with status 'dnf', 'dns' or 'dsq', or with no time, says 'Did not finish', 'Did not start' or 'Disqualified' in words and is kept below the finishers. marks ('record', 'personal-best', 'season-best') become labelled badges by the name. highlightName marks an athlete with a plate and the word 'You'. precision (0, 1 or 2) sets the digits after the second. onSelect makes each name a button. Below 48rem club, category and bib fold under the name, and below 28rem the gap folds under the time. The folded bib is written by labels.bibFolded ('#{bib}' by default; 'Lane {bib}' for a pool). labels translates every word.
